metas.name: Vikram On Duty
metas.description: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

metas.name: Brinda
metas.description: Young, socially awkward yet morally grounded SI cadet Brinda stumbles upon a brutal murder with a chilling modus operandi. As the killer slips through her grasp, she faces personal and bureaucratic turmoil, but the hardest challenge is the moral reckoning that could define her career and conscience. Will Brinda uphold justice, or lose herself in the chaos closer to home?

metas.name: 11th Hour
metas.description: Aratika Reddy is the CEO of Aditya Group and has a day to pay a debt of Rs 10,000 Cr. With rivals breathing down her neck to take over the company, stakes are high as she runs against time to save the day.

metas.name: Parampara
metas.description: When powerful, wily Naidu's ruthlessness becomes too much, his nephew, Gopi, steps up to avenge the injustice met to his father.

metas.name: Dhootha
metas.description: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.

metas.name: Shaitan
metas.description: After attempting an attack on the Home Minister, Baali is on the run. What happens when he chooses the path of violence?...

metas.name: Panchanama
metas.description: Police officer Jai Ram refuses to accept his brother Aadi's death as an accident. His investigation leads him to reopen other suspicious death cases involving Aadi, Praveen and Joseph, eventually uncovering a much larger conspiracy connected to a medical syndicate.

metas.name: The Mystery of Moksha Island
metas.description: A lavish inheritance and a pharma empire lure a dead scientist's relatives to a remote island. The excitement turns into horror when they realise it's a trap.

metas.name: Veerabhadruni Rahasyam
metas.description: A city woman challenges a village’s deadly superstitions, uncovering deep crimes behind local myths.

metas.name: Dhahanam
metas.description: The assassination of Sri Ramulu, a communist labourer, causes a stir. Sri Ramulu's oldest son, Hari, is a Naxalite rebel operating from the forest using guerrilla warfare against the landlords, and the news of his father's death infuriates him. He takes it upon himself to find the person responsible for his father's murder, which sparks a conflict between the village's most powerful goons.

metas.name: Maya Bazaar - For Sale
metas.description: High expectations of the buyers turn upside down when "Maya Bazaar", a gated community’s brand ambassador – a celebrity actor Abhijeet - falls dead from the terrace of the clubhouse on the inauguration day. On the same day, the residents also come to know that the entire property is illegal and their hope for a peaceful life comes to a standstill when the government declares the construction illegal.

metas.name: ATM
metas.description: Four street-smart youngsters from the slums of Hyderabad earn their living by carrying out petty crimes. What happens when one such scam backfires and compels them to loot a bank's cash van?

metas.name: Memu Copulam
metas.description: When a village’s star rooster vanishes, clueless cops Ravi and Mohan take the lead to solve the case. What starts as a hilarious search leads them to a conspiracy that threatens the entire community.

metas.name: GangStars
metas.description: KrishnaDas is a gangster. The doctor tells das that he has a stomach cancer. Ajay dream to become a filmmaker. Keerthi is the niece of a film stars manager. Vishwa and Aishwarya breakup during shooting refuse to work. Das threatens Ajay and Keerthi to act together. How they complete the film and does Das realise the truth of his medical condition?

metas.name: Paruvu
metas.description: Years after Sudheer and Pallavi are disowned by their families for defying the caste system, a tragedy brings them back to their hometown. Soon, they find themselves entangled in an accidental death.

metas.name: 9 Hours
metas.description: Three prisoners on run try to rob three banks. They are well-prepared and know how to run away with the booty. Is someone handling them from behind the screens?

metas.name: Azadi 501
metas.description: A dramatization of one of India's largest tech scams, where millions of buyers were deceived by the promise of an impossibly cheap phone, leading to a nationwide fraud.

metas.name: Dayaa
metas.description: A reserved freezer van driver gets pushed into a chaotic situation wants to escape to safety, an upright journalist chases the truth, a husband is on the hunt for his wife, a cop wants to make progress in his investigation, a woman is in search of her identity and a culprit is after power.

metas.name: Gaalivaana
metas.description: After newlyweds Ajay and Geetha are brutally murdered, their families come together in grief. But the situation takes a new twist when the suspected killer arrives at their doorstep.

metas.name: Shootout at Alair
metas.description: Akhtar kills a policeman every year on the day of the Mecca Masjid blasts. Soon, Akhtar is encountered. However, after several years, when a policeman gets killed on the same day, IG Praveen Chand suspects Akhtar's involvement. Is Akhtar still alive.

metas.name: Vyavastha
metas.description: Avinash Chakraborty is a ruthless lawyer who leaves no stone unturned to win a case. His authority is challenged by Vamsi Krishna, his employer's son and a newly graduated lawyer. What will he do next?

metas.name: Bahishkarana
metas.description: Pushpa, a courtesan, arrives in Peddapalli and falls in love with Darshi. While the couple prepares for their new life together, their dream to be married is shattered when Darshi gets forced to marry someone else.

metas.name: Recce
metas.description: Set in the backdrop of Anantapur, in 1993,  A dual murder takes place, setting off a series of unforeseen consequences and twists after a cop named Lenin embarks on an investigation.

metas.name: Kobali
metas.description: Two families become entangled in revenge, greed, and payback. Rising tensions unearth buried secrets that impact multiple lives.

metas.name: Viraatapalem: PC Meena Reporting
metas.description: Set in the 1980s in the remote and fear-stricken, eerie village of Viraatapalem, which faces a strange chilling curse – every bride dies mysteriously on her wedding day, halting marriages for over a decade. A determined police constable refuses to believe this superstition and, along with a reformed convict, begins to unearth shocking secrets the villagers want hidden.

metas.name: Karimnagar’s Most Wanted
metas.description: In 'Karimnagar's Most Wanted' Four small-town dreamers face adversity after a real estate deal goes wrong. Framed by a corrupt politician, they endure prison horrors. Upon release, they turn the tables, becoming feared underworld figures. A clash with an influential foe tests their mettle, leading to a relentless battle for survival.
